notes.title: Restocking Feature & Restockers are available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069872/4ad2f5b2e415168eaadcede41a23e5898bf303aa.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New Restocking gameplay that allows players to restock product on top of existing products.
[*] New Restockers service, hire new restockers to support you in running your store.
[*] New Service App UI. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fix for Trash/Stains spawning under ground.
[*] Fix for Service UI not updating cahsiar workers.
[*] Fix an issue with white powder not showing correctly.

[*] Improved collisions on cardboard boxes to allow collecting trash inside of them.
[/list]
